title: Prophylactic Administration of Vitamin C in Wrist Fractures
brief_summary: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome or posttraumatic dystrophy is a pain syndrome which develops after a trauma, surgery or for unknown reason. The incidence after wrist fractures varies in literature from 2 - 37%. The female sex is involved three times as much as the male sex. There is one study in literature which describes a prophylactic effect of vitamin C after wrist fractures. Goal of this study is to search for a dose dependent effect of vitamin C and to replicate these earlier findings.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* wrist fracture
* adult (18 years and older)

Exclusion Criteria:

* no comprehension of the written information
* not able to appear for follow-up (living abroad)
